driver: STM32N6 general-purpose I/O (GPIOA) low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 15 (GPIO) + memory map p.176
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.15 GPIO register interface + memory map p.176 (GPIOA secure base 0x56020000)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the GPIO benchmark work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure GPIOA (stm32n6xx.h), port A

Per pin: mode (GPIOx_MODER.MODEy) and mode query, output type (GPIOx_OTYPER.OTy), output speed (GPIOx_OSPEEDR.OSPEEDy), pull-up/pull-down (GPIOx_PUPDR.PUPDy), alternate function of pins 0-7 (GPIOx_AFRL.AFSELy) and 8-15 (GPIOx_AFRH.AFSELy)
Input port read and input pin query (GPIOx_IDR); output port write, read and output pin query (GPIOx_ODR); set (GPIOx_BSRR.BSy), reset (GPIOx_BRR.BRy) and toggle (GPIOx_BSRR) of the pins of a mask

Out of scope: HAL API, configuration lock (GPIOx_LCKR), TrustZone secure/privilege configuration, resource lock, delay and advanced configuration registers, EXTI, the other ports, the LL init/deinit functions of stm32n6xx_ll_gpio.c

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 015 benchmark set (owner 2026-10-25): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 GPIO LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects GPIOA_S at 0x56020000).

scope.note: per-pin configuration (mode, output type, speed, pull, alternate function), port input/output, pin set/reset/toggle
